description: This file contains CPU feature detection and setup code for Intel and AMD processors, including CPUID instruction wrappers and environment-based overrides.

methods.name: OPENSSL_cpuid
methods.description: Executes the CPUID instruction with a given leaf value, retrieving CPU feature information.

methods.name: OPENSSL_xgetbv
methods.description: Reads the value of the extended control register XCR0.

methods.name: handle_cpu_env
methods.description: Applies environment variable overrides to CPU feature flags based on specified syntax.

methods.name: OPENSSL_cpuid_setup
methods.description: Detects CPU vendor, features, and capabilities, and applies environment variable overrides.
